records.finding: memq returned nil for a gauge (biz_inflight_value) bucket with no in-bucket sample, diverging from real backends' last_over_time carry-forward and from memq's own doc ('last observed level at its step boundary'). Cross-backend drift.
records.evidence: old: QueryMetric filtered all points via !inRange(p.At, Range); aggregate gauge used '!p.At.Before(from) && p.At.Before(to)' -> nil for gapped buckets.
records.reason: Gauge samples are kept whenever At < Range.To (including before From); each bucket reports the last sample with At < boundary, carried forward; nil only when no level was ever set. Counters keep the [From,To) increase filter (no regression). Regression test TestGaugeCarriesForward (pre-window 200 -> bucket 0; 800 -> later buckets). Cross-examiner: fix_correct.

records.finding: The feeder emitted outcome events + counter metrics for abandoned txns, but 'telemetry never saw it' (checkout.StateAbandoned) — a real backend has zero abandoned rows, so the querier made the invisible visible and inflated counts/sums.
records.evidence: old terminalOf: 'case checkout.StateAbandoned: return "auth", biz.ResultAbandoned, ..., true'; checkout.go:46 '// telemetry never saw it'.
records.reason: telemetryOutcome (renamed from terminalOf) models a telemetry backend: visible=true only for settled/cap_fail/auth_fail (request genuinely landed); abandoned + all in-flight states are not-visible. Abandoned rows remain in res.Ledger for the counterfactual leg. Cross-examiner: fix_correct, all 7 states covered.
